description: This file defines API functions for interacting with loan draft backend endpoints in a React project. It includes functions for creating, listing, retrieving, updating, checking readiness, submitting, deciding, and deleting loan drafts, with internal utility for JSON serialization.

methods.name: toJsonString
methods.description: Utility function to convert a value to a JSON string, with fallback handling.

methods.name: createDraft
methods.description: Creates a new loan application draft for the authenticated user.

methods.name: listDrafts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of loan drafts for the current user.

methods.name: getDraft
methods.description: Fetches a specific draft by its ID.

methods.name: patchDraftSection
methods.description: Updates a section within a draft, including section data and status.

methods.name: checkDraftReadiness
methods.description: Checks whether a draft is ready for submission based on required sections and documents.

methods.name: submitDraft
methods.description: Submits a draft for processing, locking it from further edits.

methods.name: decideDraft
methods.description: Runs risk scoring and decisioning for a draft.

methods.name: deleteDraft
methods.description: Deletes a draft if it has not been submitted.
